image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a common iguana (Iguana iguana). The image focuses on the head and upper torso. The iguana has textured, granular scales in shades of greyish-green and brown, with a prominent dorsal crest running along the neck. A large subtympanic shield is visible below the ear area. The eye is detailed with a reddish-brown iris. The background is softly blurred (bokeh), isolating the subject.
